By mid-month Sean Duffy faced calls to resign over air travel chaos, and Democrats pushed back on his demand for $50 billion to upgrade air traffic systems. Neither story explains the late-October peak.

stocks:S68.SI.standing: The company that runs Singapore's stock and derivatives exchanges and their clearing houses. Much of its income comes from futures on Asian assets, from Chinese equities to iron ore, so trading volume drives its earnings.

poly-will-bola-tinubu-win-the-2027-niger.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Bola Tinubu wins Nigeria's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay on a second term for the president of Africa's most populous country.
poly-will-bola-tinubu-win-the-2027-niger.recent: The fortnight's one story from Nigeria's campaign came from Gombe, where armed men blocked Isa Pantami's convoy with burning tyres. It landed well after the contract's trough, and nothing in the input accounts for the price.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: What traders will pay for a contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. It prices his chances in a crowded field on the right.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares in the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the world's most valuable companies. Its OpenAI stake and its data-centre spending make it a bellwether for whether the AI build-out pays.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Outlook and Teams were disrupted for nearly a day, with Downdetector logging 130,000 Outlook outage reports at the peak, and the shares fell by 3% on the disruption. The same week a researcher leaked SignDrop, a Windows exploit that gives ordinary users System rights.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest oil and gas company, producing crude and LNG from Africa to the Middle East and the North Sea, and building a power business. This line is its New York listing, priced in dollars.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Vance called the Iran war the reason Republicans lost the midterms, and Trump told advisers he would not resume it unless provoked, after Mohammed bin Salman and Erdogan pressed him for restraint. In the same days, mines hit tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran said it downed an Orbiter 4 drone over Nahavand.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: Nvidia's board investigated Jensen Huang over his ties to Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive whose employer reportedly bought $4.8bn of Nvidia equipment. He resigned, and Colette Kress, finance chief since 2013, now runs the company, while Chinese buyers stockpile its chips before an expected US crackdown.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-on-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes Claude, lists its shares publicly on November 19, 2026. A listing would put a public market price on one of the leading AI developers for the first time.

stocks:SCC.BK.standing: Thailand's largest industrial group, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand and part-owned by the Crown Property Bureau. It makes cement, building materials, petrochemicals and packaging across Southeast Asia.
stocks:SCC.BK.recent: The one development on the company's own business came after the latest close: SCG said its core plastics plant in Vietnam, knocked out by the Hormuz disruption, stays shut until mid-2027. Nothing in the input accounts for the slide before that.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: A wartime oil market tipped into glut: JP Morgan put October's surplus at 1.4 million barrel-a-day as Saudi Arabia reported output up 26%, and Brent fell below $90 for the first time since August. Missile debris damaged Aramco Tower in Riyadh and the East-West pipeline was struck, yet the slide held.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.
poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting concerned Hegseth himself. The nearest it came was a look at whether prediction markets called the U.S. midterm election, and that does not account for this contract's move.

stocks:IBM.standing: International Business Machines, the century-old American computing company, now earns most of its money from hybrid-cloud software, Red Hat and mainframes sold to banks and governments, with a consulting arm alongside.
stocks:IBM.recent: The one development in its own business is a plan to link two 520-qubit chips into a 1,040-qubit system that users can reach in 2027, a step on its roadmap to error-corrected quantum computers before 2030. That was announced after the latest close, so it does not explain the share's climb.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: Iran is enforcing which lane ships may use rather than negotiating it. Its Guard says two tankers hit mines on what it calls the illegal southern route, days after a liquefied natural gas carrier exploded on an unauthorised route. In between, Trump posted that there was no need for an Iran deal.

stocks:TMUS.standing: One of the three national mobile carriers in the United States, majority-owned by Deutsche Telekom since it absorbed Sprint in 2020. Its subscriber fight with Verizon and AT&T carries much of the German parent's value.
stocks:TMUS.recent: New York accused T-Mobile of throttling the internet service it sells to low-income households to 600 Kbps. A state charge against its own business is a cost, not a lift, and nothing else in the input accounts for the share climbing to its high the same day.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: The one story about United's own business arrived after the climb: the airline barred AI agents such as OpenAI's dots from booking its flights on travellers' behalf, citing security concerns. It changes how tickets are sold, not how many, and nothing in the input accounts for the rise in the share.

stocks:LUV.standing: The share price of Southwest Airlines, the largest US domestic carrier by passengers, built on a single Boeing 737 fleet and point-to-point routes. It moves with jet fuel costs and with how full planes on US routes are.

poly-variational-fdv-above-800m-one-day-.standing: A bet on whether Variational's token, once it starts trading, carries a fully diluted valuation above $800 million a day later. FDV prices every token that will ever exist, not only those circulating at launch.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency with no central issuer, launched in 2009. Surges mark the moments the coin reaches people outside the trading world.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: The CLARITY Act stalled 49 to 50 in the Senate after a Democratic sweep, days after a hack sent Binance users to withdraw a net $3.64 billion. Then MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, and money left crypto for Anthropic's IPO as bitcoin fell below $70,000.

stocks:BIDU.standing: China's largest search engine, whose New York-listed shares also price its bets on Ernie AI models, Kunlun chips and Apollo Go robotaxis.
stocks:BIDU.recent: The news about Baidu this fortnight was product news: a 1,024-chip Tianchi supernode it will sell next year, and a simulator that stands in for some of the 700,000km of road testing each robotaxi model iteration needs. Neither accounts for the share price.

stocks:MSTR.standing: The former MicroStrategy, a business-software firm that became the largest listed holder of bitcoin, buying it by selling its own shares and debt. Its stock trades as a leveraged bet on the coin.
stocks:MSTR.recent: Bitcoin fell below $76K as an AI stock rout hit Strategy, Coinbase and Circle, taking the value of its 850,364 bitcoin down with it. MSCI then ruled that a company whose business is buying bitcoin is a fund and confirmed it will drop it from its indexes. Index funds must sell, and a model that sells shares and debt to buy more bitcoin loses its passive buyers.

stocks:MSCI.standing: The New York-listed firm behind the MSCI World and Emerging Markets indexes, which it licenses to fund managers with risk analytics and ESG ratings. Its fees scale with the money tracking those indexes.
stocks:MSCI.recent: The one story about the company's own business came after this window closed: on 12 November MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, putting that firm's bitcoin-buying model on the line. Nothing in the input accounts for the share's earlier rise.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, Donald Trump's vice president, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it tracks the fortunes of the heir to Trump's movement.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: Trump's party lost the midterms heavily, a result Axios called a blue tsunami. Vance then clashed with Trump over the defeat and blamed the Iran war for it, breaking publicly with the president whose voters he needs, while Trump made Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for the debacle.

stocks:C.standing: The New York-based bank with the widest overseas reach of America's largest lenders. Its treasury and trade arm moves cash for multinationals across dozens of countries, so its shares respond to global trade and interest rates.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: SpaceX's default risk hit a fresh peak in early November as a tech-led selloff built. The recovery since came alongside a plan for $74 billion in AI computing campuses and a fight over Starshield: the European Commission demanded service restored in Ukraine, where Zelensky says drones above 161 km/h are cut off.

stocks:9984.T.standing: SoftBank Group is the Tokyo-listed holding company Masayoshi Son built. Its value rests mainly on stakes in other companies, chiefly the chip designer Arm and its bets on AI, so its share price moves with the price of AI.
stocks:9984.T.recent: Over the fortnight SoftBank signed Sceye to fly stratospheric cell towers over Japan. Then, after the low, it booked more than $3 billion in losses on turbine deposits meant for AI power from natural gas. Neither event explains the fall in the share.

stocks:WHL.JO.standing: A Johannesburg-listed retailer that runs the Woolworths stores in South Africa, selling premium food, clothing and homeware, plus Country Road Group in Australia. Its food arm is a gauge of what the middle class still spends.
stocks:WHL.JO.recent: Woolworths reported that turnover at Woolworths Foods grew only 1.9% and concession sales just 0.1%. That is a sharp slowdown in the food business the group relies on to sell to South Africa's middle class, and the shares fell on the figures.

poly-will-pablo-hernandez-de-cos-be-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Pablo Hernández de Cos, the former Bank of Spain governor, succeeds Christine Lagarde at the European Central Bank, which sets interest rates for the twenty countries that use the euro.
poly-will-pablo-hernandez-de-cos-be-the-.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news touched the ECB succession. The prediction-market stories were about Polymarket itself: Trump Jr. left Kalshi as an adviser after his firm invested $300 million in its rival, and Polymarket pledged $3.9 million to victims of a site compromise.

wiki-jensen-huang.standing: Co-founder of Nvidia, the chipmaker whose graphics processors became the hardware most AI models are trained on. He led it from its founding in 1993, and its rise made him one of the most closely watched executives in technology.
wiki-jensen-huang.recent: US officials believe Chinese intelligence targeted Huang through Alice Huang, whose employer Megaspeed reportedly bought $4.8bn of Nvidia equipment, and the board opened an inquiry. After Sen. Cramer called for him to resign, Huang quit and Colette Kress became interim CEO, while Chinese buyers began stockpiling Nvidia chips.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir sells software that pulls scattered records into one searchable picture, to armies, spy agencies, police forces and large companies. Government contracts are its core, so its fortunes follow public budgets and politics.
stocks:PLTR.recent: Palantir held its Q3 2026 earnings call in the window, though nothing here says what the results contained. The one story about its business came from Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, where the Left coalition rejected Palantir yet still plans automated police data analysis. Neither accounts for the price.

stocks:MBG.DE.standing: The Stuttgart carmaker behind Mercedes-Benz cars and vans, listed in Frankfurt. Its profits lean on wealthy buyers in China and on exports to the US, so Chinese demand and tariffs reach the share quickly.
stocks:MBG.DE.recent: Four months of talks in Germany ended with Mercedes-Benz halting investment in its home country, the one development here about the company's own business. It came on the last day of the window, so it does not explain the rise before it.

stocks:ISP.MI.standing: Italy's largest bank by assets, listed in Milan. It holds a large stock of Italian government bonds, so its shares move with the spread Rome pays over Germany and with any change in how the state taxes its lenders.
stocks:ISP.MI.recent: Intesa publicly attacked the bank levies in Italy's 2027 budget, which seeks €5.9 billion from the country's banks next year, and said the ECB may intervene. That dispute surfaced after the latest reading, so it does not explain the share's path over the window.

stocks:TSLA.standing: The Austin-based maker of electric cars and of batteries that store grid power, run by Elon Musk. Its share price carries bets on driverless taxis and robots worth far more than its car sales earn.
stocks:TSLA.recent: The rebound began when Musk killed the Cybertruck, which Cox Automotive estimates sold 11,586 in nine months, to turn Tesla towards robotics and AI. Tesla then said its Cybercab meets federal safety standards, and Bloomberg reported SpaceX and Tesla were weighing a December merger announcement.

poly-us-strike-on-cuba-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States carries out a military strike on Cuba before its deadline. Its price is what traders stake on open conflict between Washington and Havana, 90 miles apart across the Florida Straits.

poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Reserve Bank of India leaves its repo rate, the rate at which it lends to commercial banks, unchanged at its December meeting. That rate sets the cost of borrowing across India.
poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.recent: The fortnight's rate news was American: Fed's Logan called for two more rate hikes after core consumer prices rose 0.3% in October, and bonds reeled on fears of a jumbo Fed hike. The only item on India said US-Iran deal uncertainty would weigh on the rupee and bonds, and none of it says what the RBI will do.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the San Francisco maker of the Claude AI models, lists its shares publicly by November 19, 2026. A listing would let ordinary investors buy into a frontier AI lab directly.

stocks:BABA.standing: The Hangzhou group behind Taobao and Tmall, China's biggest online marketplaces, and the country's largest cloud computing business. These New York-listed shares trade on Chinese consumer spending and its bets on artificial intelligence.
stocks:BABA.recent: The fortnight brought news of Alibaba's own business: Qwen chosen as the AI inside Apple's iPhone in China, a plan to list the T-Head chip unit in Hong Kong while keeping control of it, and nearly 100,000 AI monthly passes sold at one fen each. None of it accounts for the fall in the share price.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, closes its first day of public trading worth less than $1.25 trillion. It is a wager on how the market will price one of the largest AI developers.
poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.recent: The fortnight's news about this market concerned the venue, not Anthropic: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm invested $300 million in its rival Polymarket, and Polymarket pledged $3.9 million to victims of a site compromise. None of it bears on Anthropic's listing.

wiki-artificial-intelligence.standing: The field of building machines that do tasks once thought to need human intelligence, from language and vision to planning. Its large models now drive chip demand, data-centre spending and much of stock market value.
wiki-artificial-intelligence.recent: A sell-off in AI stocks spread to Asia: South Korea halted trading after the Kospi fell 8%, and copper hit its lowest since July on AI fears. OpenAI said GPT-6 Cyber found 948 Linux flaws. Nvidia was then shaken by Jensen Huang's 'confession' email and an uproar over US chip controls.

poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors visit an Iranian nuclear site by the year's end. Those inspections are the only outside check on how much enriched uranium Iran holds.
poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.recent: Tehran answered the UN watchdog's call to reopen its bombed facilities by saying inspections are impossible 'in the current security situation', and the Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty outright. Washington, unable to see inside, offered up to $20 million to informants on Iran's nuclear program instead.

poly-will-josh-shapiro-win-the-2028-demo.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for a contract that pays out if Josh Shapiro, Pennsylvania's governor, becomes the Democrats' 2028 presidential nominee. It prices a swing-state governor's place in an open, crowded field.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs China's second-largest short-video and live-streaming app after ByteDance's Douyin, and earns from advertising, live-stream tipping and e-commerce. Its shares follow Chinese ad spending and its contest with Douyin.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kuaishou's AI video unit Kling raised about 19.8 billion yuan in a round that valued it above its parent. Nothing reported in the window ties that deal to the fall in the shares.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator who became Trump's secretary of state, is the Republican presidential nominee in 2028. It prices him against the field to succeed Trump.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.recent: The fortnight's news on prediction markets was about the industry, not the race. Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival Polymarket, and Polymarket pledged $3.9 million to victims of a site compromise. None of it bears on Rubio's chances.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: The world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries, based in Ningde, Fujian, and listed in Shenzhen. Its cells go into cars from Tesla to BMW, so its share moves on Chinese EV sales, lithium prices and Western trade rules.

wiki-tass.standing: Russia's state-owned news agency and the oldest wire service in the country, dating to the Soviet era. Newsrooms abroad quote it as the official Russian account of events, from the Kremlin's diplomacy to the war in Ukraine.
wiki-tass.recent: Members of the European Alliance of News Agencies voted in a secret ballot to expel TASS, which had been suspended since February 2022; earlier expulsion votes, needing a three-quarters majority, failed in 2022 and 2024, TASS reported. None of it accounts for the earlier, larger peak.

poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a peace deal before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on talks, battlefield turns and Washington's diplomacy.
poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.recent: Trump met Putin envoy Kirill Dmitriev at the White House and promised a 'big, beautiful agreement', and the first Russia-Ukraine talks in 9 months opened in Abu Dhabi. TASS then reported Putin was not ready to make peace there, and Zelensky said the US had raised a Donbas withdrawal in exchange for NATO entry.

poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Chiang Wan-an, the Kuomintang mayor of Taipei, wins the city's next mayoral race. Taiwan's capital has twice sent its mayor on to the presidency, so the seat is read as a test of the parties' national strength.
poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting concerns Taipei or its mayoral race, and none of it accounts for the price. The nearest item is about the venue itself: Donald Trump Jr. left his adviser role at Kalshi after his venture firm invested $300 million in its rival Polymarket.

poly-will-no-listed-leader-be-out-before.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out only if every national leader on the market's list is still in office when 2027 begins. Its price is what traders will pay on incumbents outlasting elections, coups, resignations and deaths.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an effective ceasefire before its deadline. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on a truce, not a forecast of one.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: The slide followed Iran's Guards claiming to have destroyed a US radar in Bahrain, and Trump's Iran post that sent Brent higher within minutes. Bets recovered once Trump told advisers he will not resume the war unless provoked, after Mohammed bin Salman and Erdogan pressed for restraint, even as mines hit tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

stocks:UPS.standing: United Parcel Service, the Atlanta-based carrier that moves parcels by truck and by its own cargo airline, hubbed at Louisville. Its volumes track consumer spending and online shopping, and its costs track fuel and labour contracts.

stocks:HMC.standing: Honda's American depositary shares on the New York Stock Exchange, priced in dollars. The Tokyo company is the world's largest motorcycle maker and a major carmaker, so the yen and US tariffs on Japanese cars both reach this price.
stocks:HMC.recent: Honda reported profit up 66%, carried by its motorcycles while its car business still lost money. That result landed after the chart's last close, so it does not account for the move within it.

poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the first lawmaker Israel's president asks to form a government after the 2026 vote succeeds, so that no second candidate is handed the mandate. Each failed round brings Israel closer to another election.
poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.recent: 67 lawmakers recommended Eisenkot to form the government against 46 for Netanyahu. Eisenkot's Yashar party then opened unity talks with Likud, even as he said Netanyahu cannot stay in office a minute longer. His price is an inquiry into 7 October, an end to the war on Iran, and Ben-Gvir and Smotrich out of cabinet.

poly-howard-lutnick-out-as-secretary-of-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Howard Lutnick leaves the post of US Commerce Secretary before the year ends. His department runs tariff investigations and export controls, so who leads it shapes US trade policy.

stocks:COL.AX.standing: Coles Group runs one of Australia's two dominant supermarket chains, alongside Woolworths, plus liquor stores such as Liquorland. Its shares trade on food inflation, wage costs and regulators' scrutiny of grocery pricing.
stocks:COL.AX.recent: The one story about Coles was its disclosure of a cyber attack, made without saying what happened. That disclosure came after this window closed, so it does not account for the slide.

poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve leaves its policy rate unchanged at its January 2027 meeting. Its price is what traders will pay for a pause, set against a hike or a cut.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: Core consumer prices rose 0.3% in October, and Logan called for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly. Two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points on fears of a half-point move, and Williams, Collins and Schmid followed, each arguing that inflation left the Fed with more work to do.

stocks:WOW.AX.standing: Australia's largest supermarket chain, which also owns the Big W discount stores and the New Zealand Countdown grocery network. Its prices and margins sit at the centre of the country's long-running argument over the cost of food.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest memory-chip maker after Samsung, and the leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside Nvidia's AI processors. Its share price is a read on how much the AI build-out is spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: The fortnight's news on SK Hynix was about building: crews working 24/7 on its first fab at Yongin, a plant set to stand 150 metres tall, and a $1 billion fund with a testing hub for smaller Korean chip suppliers. None of it explains the fall in the share.

stocks:AMZN.standing: The world's largest online retailer and, through Amazon Web Services, the biggest seller of cloud computing. AWS earns most of the company's operating profit, so the share moves on cloud demand as much as on shopping.
stocks:AMZN.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news explains the share's run. The one story about Amazon's own business landed after the last close: a ULA Vulcan failed 10 minutes after liftoff and lost all 40 Amazon Leo satellites aboard, a setback for a Starlink rival that depends on scarce non-SpaceX launches and faces an FCC deployment deadline.

poly-will-nicols-maduro-be-the-leader-of.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Nicolás Maduro still holds power in Venezuela at the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on succession talk, sanctions and pressure from Washington.

poly-will-nvidia-be-the-largest-company-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if NVIDIA is the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation when the year closes. It is a bet on whether the AI chipmaker keeps its lead over Apple and Microsoft.

poly-will-anthropic-have-the-best-ai-mod.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the maker of Claude, holds the top spot on a public chatbot leaderboard at the end of November 2026. Rival labs ship new models every few weeks, and any release can reorder it.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's largest lender, listed in Frankfurt and run with a large investment-banking arm. The price tracks European interest rates, trading income and the bank's legal and credit costs.

poly-will-christine-lagarde-win-the-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Christine Lagarde, the former French finance minister who now heads the European Central Bank, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it moves against rivals for the party's nomination.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.recent: The fortnight's news was the midterm election, which Axios called a blowout, and the fallout inside the Republican camp: JD Vance clashed with Trump over the result and blamed the Iran war for the defeat. None of it concerned Rubio, and none of it accounts for the price.

poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-dem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Kamala Harris becomes the Democratic Party's presidential nominee for 2028. Its price is what traders will pay on her winning a primary field that has not yet formed.
poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-dem.recent: The fortnight's news about this contract concerned Polymarket itself, not Harris: Trump Jr.'s firm put $300 million into it, and he left his adviser role at its rival Kalshi. Nothing in it touches Harris or the race for the nomination.

stocks:CBK.DE.standing: Germany's second-largest listed bank, based in Frankfurt and a main lender to the Mittelstand, the mid-sized firms behind German exports. The German state has held a stake in it since rescuing it in the 2008 crisis.
stocks:CBK.DE.recent: The share trades on UniCredit's €45 billion bid, which won unconditional approval from the European Commission and from the US Fed. Competition chief Teresa Ribera warned that Brussels will intervene if Berlin tries to block it, which sets the Commission against the government that holds a stake in the target.
